description: Documentation-only (needs ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR): stream a large sandbox file into the archive with bounded memory. sourcePath names a file relative to the sandbox and stream: true feeds it through addStream (data-descriptor layout — reproducible but inspect_zip reports canonicalLayout: false; entries above 4 GiB are refused with ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_ZIP64_STREAMING). outputMode 'file' streams the archive to disk (never overwrites) and returns a resource_link.
